title: GO:0000018: PCA of k-sep. bigram PSSM
caption: PCA projection of all 1500 proteins in the GO:0000018 pool, described by k-sep. bigram PSSM (400 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: 0.02. The first two components explain 72.8% and 5.3% of variance. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
